scripts/run_mooring_final.py.name: Choosing the final arrangement
scripts/run_mooring_final.py.description: Compares the twelve shortlisted ways of tying the platform to the boat, including rigid tubes, and ranks them on load, slack and how much the boat rolls.

scripts/run_mooring_study.py.name: The full mooring sweep
scripts/run_mooring_study.py.description: Tries every combination of arrangement, rope stiffness and tightness, in still water and in three waves, to find what actually works.
